# SGLang native option reference

<!-- Generated by python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs; edit reference-help.json or source definitions. -->

Use these names under [miles]. Defaults below come from the pinned parser **before** structured, backend and model-dependent resolution. Some inherited options are inapplicable to Core; see the restrictions column and [run controls](run-controls.md). Parser acceptance is not qualification. Source help describes the upstream runtime, which may mention other backends.

[Reference index and provenance](native-options.md).

| TOML key | Native flags | Type/action | Choices | Parser default | Core restriction | Help (source or reviewed supplement) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| sglang_router_ip | --sglang-router-ip | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | IP address of the SGLang router |
| sglang_router_port | --sglang-router-port | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Port of the SGLang router |
| sglang_router_policy | --sglang-router-policy | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Routing policy for the SGLang router (e.g., &#x27;consistent_hashing&#x27;, &#x27;round_robin&#x27;) |
| sglang_router_request_timeout_secs | --sglang-router-request-timeout-secs | int | — | 14400 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Timeout for requests to the SGLang router in seconds |
| sglang_server_concurrency | --sglang-server-concurrency | int | — | 512 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Client request concurrency per engine; raise together with engine admission and cache capacity. |
| sglang_tokenizer_path | --sglang-tokenizer-path | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The path of the tokenizer. |
| sglang_tokenizer_mode | --sglang-tokenizer-mode | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;slow&quot;] | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Tokenizer mode. &#x27;auto&#x27; will use the fast tokenizer if available, and &#x27;slow&#x27; will always use the slow tokenizer. |
| sglang_tokenizer_backend | --sglang-tokenizer-backend | str | [&quot;fastokens&quot;, &quot;huggingface&quot;] | &quot;huggingface&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Tokenizer backend. &#x27;huggingface&#x27; uses the default HuggingFace tokenizers library, and &#x27;fastokens&#x27; uses the fastokens library for faster tokenization. Requires the fastokens package to be installed. |
| sglang_tokenizer_worker_num | --sglang-tokenizer-worker-num | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The worker num of the tokenizer manager. |
| sglang_detokenizer_worker_num | --sglang-detokenizer-worker-num | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The worker num of the detokenizer manager. |
| sglang_skip_tokenizer_init | --sglang-skip-tokenizer-init | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | If set, skip init tokenizer and pass input_ids in generate request. |
| sglang_load_format | --sglang-load-format | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;bitsandbytes&quot;, &quot;dummy&quot;, &quot;fastsafetensors&quot;, &quot;flash_rl&quot;, &quot;gguf&quot;, &quot;layered&quot;, &quot;mistral&quot;, &quot;npcache&quot;, &quot;presharded&quot;, &quot;private&quot;, &quot;pt&quot;, &quot;remote&quot;, &quot;remote_instance&quot;, &quot;runai_streamer&quot;, &quot;safetensors&quot;, &quot;sharded_state&quot;] | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The format of the model weights to load. &quot;auto&quot; will try to load the weights in the safetensors format and fall back to the pytorch bin format if safetensors format is not available. &quot;pt&quot; will load the weights in the pytorch bin format. &quot;safetensors&quot; will load the weights in the safetensors format. &quot;npcache&quot; will load the weights in pytorch format and store a numpy cache to speed up the loading. &quot;dummy&quot; will initialize the weights with random values, which is mainly for profiling.&quot;gguf&quot; will load the weights in the gguf format. &quot;bitsandbytes&quot; will load the weights using bitsandbytes quantization.&quot;layered&quot; loads weights layer by layer so that one can quantize a layer before loading another to make the peak memory envelope smaller.&quot;presharded&quot; performs a normal first-time load (with quantization), then dumps a per-rank/per-tensor sharded checkpoint with content deduplication into &lt;model_path&gt;/presharded/&lt;parallelism+quant subfolder&gt;/. Subsequent runs with the same parallelism+quantization config load directly from this presharded checkpoint and skip re-quantization. The dump directory must be on a shared filesystem across all ranks/nodes. Optional model_loader_extra_config roots: presharded_path (target) and draft_presharded_path (speculative draft); each replaces &lt;model_path&gt;/presharded and still gets a config subfolder appended. Use a writable path when model_path is read-only (e.g. HF cache mounts). |
| sglang_model_loader_extra_config | --sglang-model-loader-extra-config | str | — | &quot;{}&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Extra config for model loader. This will be passed to the model loader corresponding to the chosen load_format. For load_format=presharded, JSON may include presharded_path (target cache root), draft_presharded_path (draft cache root), max_file_bytes, hash_num_threads, and verify_on_load. |
| sglang_context_length | --sglang-context-length | human_readable_int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The model&#x27;s maximum context length. Defaults to None (will use the value from the model&#x27;s config.json instead).  Supports standard SI suffixes (k, M, G, T) and IEC suffixes     (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti). Suffixes are case-sensitive.      Decimals are allowed for SI suffixes only.      Examples:         &#x27;1k&#x27; -&gt; 1000      &#x27;1M&#x27; -&gt; 1000000    &#x27;25.6k&#x27; -&gt; 25600         &#x27;1Ki&#x27; -&gt; 1024     &#x27;1Mi&#x27; -&gt; 1048576      |
| sglang_is_embedding | --sglang-is-embedding | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Whether to use a CausalLM as an embedding model. |
| sglang_enable_multimodal | --sglang-enable-multimodal | switch | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable the multimodal functionality for the served model. If the model being served is not multimodal, nothing will happen |
| sglang_revision | --sglang-revision | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The specific model version to use. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version. |
| sglang_model_impl | --sglang-model-impl | str | — | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Which implementation of the model to use.  * &quot;auto&quot; will try to use the SGLang implementation if it exists and fall back to the Transformers implementation if no SGLang implementation is available. * &quot;sglang&quot; will use the SGLang model implementation. * &quot;transformers&quot; will use the Transformers model * &quot;mindspore&quot; will use the MindSpore model implementation.  |
| sglang_model_config_parser | --sglang-model-config-parser | str | — | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Which model-config parser to use. &quot;auto&quot; picks &quot;mistral&quot; via the is_mistral_model name heuristic, else &quot;hf&quot; (AutoConfig over config.json). Plugins can register additional parsers via @register_model_config_parser. |
| sglang_json_model_override_args | --sglang-json-model-override-args | str | — | &quot;{}&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | A dictionary in JSON string format used to override default model configurations. |
| sglang_dtype | --sglang-dtype | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;bfloat16&quot;, &quot;float&quot;, &quot;float16&quot;, &quot;float32&quot;, &quot;half&quot;] | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Data type for model weights and activations.  * &quot;auto&quot; will use FP16 precision for FP32 and FP16 models, and BF16 precision for BF16 models. * &quot;half&quot; for FP16. Recommended for AWQ quantization. * &quot;float16&quot; is the same as &quot;half&quot;. * &quot;bfloat16&quot; for a balance between precision and range. * &quot;float&quot; is shorthand for FP32 precision. * &quot;float32&quot; for FP32 precision. |
| sglang_quantization | --sglang-quantization | str | [&quot;auto-round&quot;, &quot;auto-round-int8&quot;, &quot;awq&quot;, &quot;awq_marlin&quot;, &quot;bitsandbytes&quot;, &quot;compressed-tensors&quot;, &quot;fp8&quot;, &quot;gguf&quot;, &quot;gptq&quot;, &quot;gptq_marlin&quot;, &quot;humming&quot;, &quot;marlin&quot;, &quot;mlx_q4&quot;, &quot;mlx_q8&quot;, &quot;modelopt&quot;, &quot;modelopt_fp4&quot;, &quot;modelopt_fp8&quot;, &quot;modelopt_mixed&quot;, &quot;modelslim&quot;, &quot;moe_wna16&quot;, &quot;mxfp4&quot;, &quot;mxfp8&quot;, &quot;mxfp_w4a8&quot;, &quot;nvfp4_online&quot;, &quot;petit_nvfp4&quot;, &quot;quark&quot;, &quot;quark_int4fp8_moe&quot;, &quot;quark_mxfp4&quot;, &quot;unquant&quot;, &quot;w4afp8&quot;, &quot;w8a8_fp8&quot;, &quot;w8a8_int8&quot;] | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The quantization method. |
| sglang_quantization_param_path | --sglang-quantization-param-path | nullable_str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to the JSON file containing the KV cache scaling factors. This should generally be supplied, when KV cache dtype is FP8. Otherwise, KV cache scaling factors default to 1.0, which may cause accuracy issues.  |
| sglang_kv_cache_dtype | --sglang-kv-cache-dtype | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;bf16&quot;, &quot;bfloat16&quot;, &quot;fp4_e2m1&quot;, &quot;fp4_mx_block16&quot;, &quot;fp8_e4m3&quot;, &quot;fp8_e5m2&quot;, &quot;mxfp8&quot;, &quot;nvfp4&quot;] | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Data type for kv cache storage. &quot;auto&quot; will use model data type. &quot;bf16&quot; or &quot;bfloat16&quot; for BF16 KV cache. &quot;fp8_e5m2&quot; and &quot;fp8_e4m3&quot; are supported for CUDA 11.8+. &quot;mxfp8&quot; is supported by the FA4 backend. &quot;nvfp4&quot; selects the NVFP4 FP4 E2M1 KV cache recipe; &quot;fp4_mx_block16&quot; selects the MX-style block-size-16 FP4 E2M1 KV cache recipe. Both require CUDA 12.8+ and PyTorch 2.8.0+ |
| sglang_enable_fp32_lm_head | --sglang-enable-fp32-lm-head | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | If set, the LM head outputs (logits) are in FP32. |
| sglang_modelopt_quant | --sglang-modelopt-quant | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The ModelOpt quantization configuration. Supported values: &#x27;fp8&#x27;, &#x27;int4_awq&#x27;, &#x27;w4a8_awq&#x27;, &#x27;nvfp4&#x27;, &#x27;nvfp4_awq&#x27;. This requires the NVIDIA Model Optimizer library to be installed: pip install nvidia-modelopt |
| sglang_modelopt_checkpoint_restore_path | --sglang-modelopt-checkpoint-restore-path | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to restore a previously saved ModelOpt quantized checkpoint. If provided, the quantization process will be skipped and the model will be loaded from this checkpoint. |
| sglang_modelopt_checkpoint_save_path | --sglang-modelopt-checkpoint-save-path | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to save the ModelOpt quantized checkpoint after quantization. This allows reusing the quantized model in future runs. |
| sglang_modelopt_export_path | --sglang-modelopt-export-path | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to export the quantized model in HuggingFace format after ModelOpt quantization. The exported model can then be used directly with SGLang for inference. If not provided, the model will not be exported. |
| sglang_quantize_and_serve | --sglang-quantize-and-serve | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Quantize the model with ModelOpt and immediately serve it without exporting. This is useful for development and prototyping. For production, it&#x27;s recommended to use separate quantization and deployment steps. |
| sglang_rl_quant_profile | --sglang-rl-quant-profile | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to the FlashRL quantization profile. Required when using --load-format flash_rl. |
| sglang_enable_tf32_matmul | --sglang-enable-tf32-matmul | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable float32 matmuls to use TensorFloat32 precision for better performance (via torch.set_float32_matmul_precision). CUDA only. |
| sglang_mem_fraction_static | --sglang-mem-fraction-static | float | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The fraction of the memory used for static allocation (model weights and KV cache memory pool). Use a smaller value if you see out-of-memory errors. |
| sglang_max_running_requests | --sglang-max-running-requests | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of running requests. |
| sglang_max_queued_requests | --sglang-max-queued-requests | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of queued requests. This option is ignored when using disaggregation-mode. |
| sglang_max_total_tokens | --sglang-max-total-tokens | human_readable_int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of tokens in the memory pool. If not specified, it will be automatically calculated based on the memory usage fraction. This option is typically used for development and debugging purposes.  Supports standard SI suffixes (k, M, G, T) and IEC suffixes     (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti). Suffixes are case-sensitive.      Decimals are allowed for SI suffixes only.      Examples:         &#x27;1k&#x27; -&gt; 1000      &#x27;1M&#x27; -&gt; 1000000    &#x27;25.6k&#x27; -&gt; 25600         &#x27;1Ki&#x27; -&gt; 1024     &#x27;1Mi&#x27; -&gt; 1048576      |
| sglang_chunked_prefill_size | --sglang-chunked-prefill-size | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of tokens in a chunk for the chunked prefill. Setting this to -1 means disabling chunked prefill. |
| sglang_enable_dynamic_chunking | --sglang-enable-dynamic-chunking | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable dynamic chunk size adjustment for pipeline parallelism. When enabled, chunk sizes are dynamically calculated based on fitted function to maintain consistent execution time across chunks. |
| sglang_max_prefill_tokens | --sglang-max-prefill-tokens | human_readable_int | — | 16384 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of tokens in a prefill batch. The real bound will be the maximum of this value and the model&#x27;s maximum context length.  Supports standard SI suffixes (k, M, G, T) and IEC suffixes     (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti). Suffixes are case-sensitive.      Decimals are allowed for SI suffixes only.      Examples:         &#x27;1k&#x27; -&gt; 1000      &#x27;1M&#x27; -&gt; 1000000    &#x27;25.6k&#x27; -&gt; 25600         &#x27;1Ki&#x27; -&gt; 1024     &#x27;1Mi&#x27; -&gt; 1048576      |
| sglang_prefill_max_requests | --sglang-prefill-max-requests | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum number of requests in a prefill batch. If not specified, there is no limit. |
| sglang_schedule_policy | --sglang-schedule-policy | str | [&quot;dfs-weight&quot;, &quot;fcfs&quot;, &quot;lof&quot;, &quot;lpm&quot;, &quot;priority&quot;, &quot;random&quot;, &quot;routing-key&quot;] | &quot;fcfs&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The scheduling policy of the requests. |
| sglang_enable_priority_scheduling | --sglang-enable-priority-scheduling | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable priority scheduling. Requests with higher priority integer values will be scheduled first by default. |
| sglang_disable_priority_preemption | --sglang-disable-priority-preemption | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable priority scheduling preemption. |
| sglang_default_priority_value | --sglang-default-priority-value | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Default priority for requests without explicit priority. |
| sglang_abort_on_priority_when_disabled | --sglang-abort-on-priority-when-disabled | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | If set, abort requests that specify a priority when priority scheduling is disabled. |
| sglang_schedule_low_priority_values_first | --sglang-schedule-low-priority-values-first | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | If specified with --enable-priority-scheduling, the scheduler will schedule requests with lower priority integer values first. |
| sglang_priority_scheduling_preemption_threshold | --sglang-priority-scheduling-preemption-threshold | int | — | 10 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Minimum difference in priorities for an incoming request to have to preempt running request(s). |
| sglang_retraction_policy | --sglang-retraction-policy | str | [&quot;length&quot;, &quot;priority&quot;] | &quot;length&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The decode retraction policy to use when the KV cache is full. &#x27;length&#x27; preserves the existing behavior and retracts short-output, long-input requests first. &#x27;priority&#x27; retracts lower-priority requests first, using the same priority direction as priority scheduling. |
| sglang_schedule_conservativeness | --sglang-schedule-conservativeness | float | — | 1.0 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | How conservative the schedule policy is. A larger value means more conservative scheduling. Use a larger value if you see requests being retracted frequently. |
| sglang_page_size | --sglang-page-size | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The number of tokens in a page. |
| sglang_c128_page_size | --sglang-c128-page-size | int | — | 16 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The physical page size of the NPU DSV4 C128 KV cache. Must be a positive multiple of 16. |
| sglang_swa_full_tokens_ratio | --sglang-swa-full-tokens-ratio | float | — | 0.8 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The ratio of SWA layer KV tokens / full layer KV tokens, regardless of the number of swa:full layers. It should be between 0 and 1. E.g. 0.5 means if each swa layer has 50 tokens, then each full layer has 100 tokens. |
| sglang_disable_hybrid_swa_memory | --sglang-disable-hybrid-swa-memory | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable the hybrid SWA memory pool. |
| sglang_radix_eviction_policy | --sglang-radix-eviction-policy | str | [&quot;lfu&quot;, &quot;lru&quot;, &quot;priority&quot;, &quot;slru&quot;] | &quot;lru&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The eviction policy of radix trees. &#x27;lru&#x27; stands for Least Recently Used, &#x27;lfu&#x27; stands for Least Frequently Used, &#x27;slru&#x27; stands for Segmented Least Recently Used, and &#x27;priority&#x27; evicts lower-priority requests first. |
| sglang_prefill_only_disable_kv_cache | --sglang-prefill-only-disable-kv-cache | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Skip the physical KV cache allocation for embedding-mode prefill-only workloads. Currently only valid with --is-embedding, --chunked-prefill-size=-1, --disable-radix-cache, an FA prefill backend, and non-FP4 KV cache so the fa_skip_kv_cache path is active (no layer reads or writes the cache). Other prefill-only workloads such as scoring/MIS may benefit from this later once their attention paths stop using paged KV. Scheduler admission accounting is unchanged; per-layer K/V tensors are sized to (page_size, head_num, head_dim) placeholders so GPU memory is not wasted. |
| sglang_disable_radix_cache | --sglang-disable-radix-cache | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable RadixAttention for prefix caching. |
| sglang_enable_page_major_kv_layout | --sglang-enable-page-major-kv-layout | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable the page-major KV layout: lay out the Mamba state and full/SWA KV caches in a page-granularity envelope (page is the outermost axis, layer-major within a page) instead of the default per-layer (layer-major) layout. Requires the Triton attention / linear-attn / Mamba backends. |
| sglang_enable_unified_memory | --sglang-enable-unified-memory | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Replace the statically-partitioned hybrid-model pools (full-attn KV + SWA/Mamba state) with one byte buffer split dynamically between sub-pools. Requires the Triton attention / linear-attn / Mamba backends; not yet compatible with PD disaggregation or speculative decoding. |
| sglang_disable_chunked_prefix_cache | --sglang-disable-chunked-prefix-cache | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable chunked prefix cache feature for deepseek, which should save overhead for short sequences. |
| sglang_disable_overlap_schedule | --sglang-disable-overlap-schedule | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable the overlap scheduler, which overlaps the CPU scheduler with GPU model worker. |
| sglang_num_continuous_decode_steps | --sglang-num-continuous-decode-steps | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Run multiple continuous decoding steps to reduce scheduling overhead. This can potentially increase throughput but may also increase time-to-first-token latency. The default value is 1, meaning only run one decoding step at a time. |
| sglang_scheduler_recv_interval | --sglang-scheduler-recv-interval | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The interval to poll requests in scheduler. Can be set to &gt;1 to reduce the overhead of this. |
| sglang_enable_mixed_chunk | --sglang-enable-mixed-chunk | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enabling mixing prefill and decode in a batch when using chunked prefill. |
| sglang_dist_timeout | --sglang-dist-timeout | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Set timeout for torch.distributed initialization. |
| sglang_gated_launch_port | --sglang-gated-launch-port | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The port of the gated launch control server. When set, every rank blocks right after the distributed environment is initialized, before any sizable GPU allocation, until `POST /gate/activate` is sent to this port on the host of the first rank. This lets an external orchestrator defer the memory hungry part of startup to a safe window. Defaults to None, which disables the gate. |
| sglang_tp_size | --sglang-tp-size, --sglang-tensor-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The tensor parallelism size. |
| sglang_dcp_size | --sglang-dcp-size, --sglang-decode-context-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The decode context parallelism size. |
| sglang_pp_size | --sglang-pp-size, --sglang-pipeline-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The pipeline parallelism size. |
| sglang_pp_max_micro_batch_size | --sglang-pp-max-micro-batch-size | int | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The maximum micro batch size in pipeline parallelism. |
| sglang_pp_async_batch_depth | --sglang-pp-async-batch-depth | int | — | 0 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The async batch depth of pipeline parallelism. |
| sglang_dp_size | --sglang-dp-size, --sglang-data-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The data parallelism size. |
| sglang_load_balance_method | --sglang-load-balance-method | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;follow_bootstrap_room&quot;, &quot;round_robin&quot;, &quot;total_requests&quot;, &quot;total_tokens&quot;] | &quot;auto&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The load balancing strategy for data parallelism. |
| sglang_attn_cp_size | --sglang-attn-cp-size, --sglang-attention-context-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The attention context parallelism size. |
| sglang_moe_dp_size | --sglang-moe-dp-size, --sglang-moe-data-parallel-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The moe data parallelism size. |
| sglang_dwdp_size | --sglang-dwdp-size | int | — | 1 | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | DWDP (Distributed Weight Data Parallelism) group size. When &gt; 1, MoE prefill uses weight prefetch instead of token all-to-all. Must equal tp_size. Only supported with --disaggregation-mode null or prefill. |
| sglang_dcp_comm_backend | --sglang-dcp-comm-backend | str | [&quot;a2a&quot;, &quot;ag_rs&quot;, &quot;fi_a2a&quot;] | &quot;ag_rs&quot; | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Communication backend for the decode context-parallel (DCP) attention reduction: &#x27;ag_rs&#x27; (AllGather + ReduceScatter), &#x27;a2a&#x27; (fused NCCL All-to-All exchange of output+LSE + local Triton LSE combine), or &#x27;fi_a2a&#x27; (FlashInfer MNNVL All-to-All kernel; requires SM90+ and MNNVL fabric memory, e.g. GB200 NVL72). |
| sglang_dcp_replicate_q_proj | --sglang-dcp-replicate-q-proj, --no-sglang-dcp-replicate-q-proj | boolean | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | For MLA decode context parallelism with the a2a/fi_a2a backend: replicate the Q projection so each DCP rank computes the full-head query locally (redundant projection compute), eliminating the per-layer head-dim all-gather of Q. Trades a small amount of extra GEMM for one fewer collective per layer. Use --no-dcp-replicate-q-proj to disable the model-specific default. |
| sglang_enable_prefill_cp | --sglang-enable-prefill-cp | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable context parallelism for the prefill phase. Select the layout with --cp-strategy. |
| sglang_cp_strategy | --sglang-cp-strategy | str | [&quot;interleave&quot;, &quot;zigzag&quot;] | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Sharding strategy for prefill CP. &#x27;zigzag&#x27; is the former in-seq-split mode; &#x27;interleave&#x27; is the former round-robin-split mode. |
| sglang_enable_dsa_cache_layer_split | --sglang-enable-dsa-cache-layer-split | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Split DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) GPU KV/indexer cache layers across context-parallel ranks to reduce per-rank KV memory. Currently only supported with the mooncake transfer backend (mooncake / mooncake_tcp); mori/nixl support will be added later by the community. |
| sglang_enable_cp_decode_attn_tp | --sglang-enable-cp-decode-attn-tp | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable attention tensor-parallel weight slicing during decode under context parallel (cp_size&gt;1). Slices the replicated attention linears to the local CP partition, eliminating redundant decode GEMMs. |
| sglang_enable_dp_attention | --sglang-enable-dp-attention | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enabling data parallelism for attention and tensor parallelism for FFN. The dp size should be equal to the tp size. Currently DeepSeek-V2 and Qwen 2/3 MoE models are supported. |
| sglang_enable_dp_attention_local_control_broadcast | --sglang-enable-dp-attention-local-control-broadcast | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | With DP-attention, send control messages to every DP group leader and broadcast within attn_tp_group instead of the full tp_group. Eliminates a costly all-ranks gloo sync on every scheduler iteration. |
| sglang_enable_dp_lm_head | --sglang-enable-dp-lm-head | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable vocabulary parallel across the attention TP group to avoid all-gather across DP groups, optimizing performance under DP attention. |
| sglang_enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all | --sglang-enable-tp-lm-head-all-to-all, --no-sglang-enable-tp-lm-head-all-to-all | boolean | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Use all-to-all instead of TP all-gather followed by DP scatter for the TP-sharded LM head under DP attention. By default this is enabled only on decode-only PD nodes with pure DP attention (tp_size == dp_size &gt; 1 and attn_cp_size == 1), and disabled on prefill-only and colocated nodes. Pass --no-enable-tp-lm-head-all-to-all to opt out. The path is incompatible with --enable-dp-lm-head; batches without an equal padded row count fall back to the existing all-gather path. |
| sglang_enable_attn_tp_input_scattered | --sglang-enable-attn-tp-input-scattered | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Allow input of attention to be scattered when only using tensor parallelism, to reduce the computational load of operations such as qkv latent. |
| sglang_disable_attn_tp_gather | --sglang-disable-attn-tp-gather | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Disable scheduler-side attn_tp_gather (the upstream SP path that pads num_tokens to attn_tp_size and pre-allocates a gathered buffer). Use for models that manage SP scatter/gather at the model level (e.g., perform their own all_gather/reduce_scatter inside attention) and do not consume the upstream gathered_buffer. Without this, the cuda graph runner pads num_tokens to attn_tp_size, which can cause kernel autotuners to select wrong-sized variants at small batches. |
| sglang_enable_p2p_check | --sglang-enable-p2p-check | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Enable P2P check for GPU access, otherwise the p2p access is allowed by default. |
| sglang_device | --sglang-device | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | The device to use (&#x27;cuda&#x27;, &#x27;xpu&#x27;, &#x27;hpu&#x27;, &#x27;npu&#x27;, &#x27;cpu&#x27;, &#x27;musa&#x27;). Defaults to auto-detection if not specified. |
| sglang_mlx_enable_sampling | --sglang-mlx-enable-sampling | switch | — | false | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | MLX backend only: sample decode tokens (temperature / top-k / top-p / min-p) instead of greedy argmax. Sampling runs inside the lazy MLX graph, so it works with the overlap scheduler; first tokens from prefill/extend are sampled too. Greedy requests keep exact argmax behavior. Also enables on the MLX path: grammar vocab masks and custom logit processors (these break decode chaining per step; custom processors run on pure-decode steps only), logit_bias, output logprobs (sampled token / top-k / token_ids; prompt input logprobs are not computed), NaN sanitization (SGLANG_SANITIZE_NAN_LOGITS), and per-request sampling_seed under --enable-deterministic-inference (deterministic within MLX only). Fill the per-request verify lengths so the total verify-token count reaches the cuda-graph tier the forward is already padded to: round the dp-max scheduled total up to the captured token bucket and let the top-k allocator admit that many real draft tokens (confidence-ordered). This recovers the padding the forward pays for anyway -- both the cuda-graph bucket round-up and the dp cross-rank max -- turning it into extra real verification at the same step time. Off by default; when off the schedule is byte-for-byte unchanged. |

Can be one of &#x27;prefill&#x27; (default) or &#x27;decode&#x27;. |

| sglang_speculative_draft_kv_cache_dtype | --sglang-speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype | str | [&quot;auto&quot;, &quot;bf16&quot;, &quot;bfloat16&quot;, &quot;fp8_e4m3&quot;, &quot;fp8_e5m2&quot;] | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | KV cache dtype for the speculative draft model only. The draft pool is allocated with one slot per target token (draft and target share a slot index space), so for a small draft it can still rival the target pool: a 5-layer DFLASH draft costs 10240 bytes/token in bf16. Setting fp8_e4m3 halves the draft pool; the saving shows up as free device memory, so raise --mem-fraction-static to convert it into KV capacity. Default follows --kv-cache-dtype. |

For Llama EAGLE-3, the drafter only attends to the most recent N keys (verifier hidden states + its own outputs); the verifier is unaffected. For DFLASH, the draft worker keeps a recent target-token window in its local KV cache (paged backends may retain up to one extra page on the left for alignment). Default is full attention/context. |

| sglang_config | --sglang-config | str | — | null | Parser option; subject to Core/model/runtime validation | Path to a YAML config for SGLang engine deployment. Defines server_groups with worker_type (regular/prefill/decode/placeholder), num_gpus per group, and optional per-group &#x27;overrides&#x27; dict of ServerArgs field names that override the base --sglang-* CLI args. Placeholder groups reserve GPU slots without creating engines. A &#x27;name: eval&#x27; model is filled in from the --eval-* args (model_path, num_gpus_per_engine, --eval-sglang-* overrides) wherever the YAML leaves them unset. Mutually exclusive with --prefill-num-servers. |
